name: hn-classic
description: A link-and-discussion theme: a coloured header bar, ranked story rows, threaded comments with no-JS vote and flag forms, Verdana, light and dark with a reader switch, works without JavaScript.

width.title: Page width
width.description: wide keeps the classic centred column (85%); full uses the whole window.

plugin_actions.title: Comment vote and flag buttons
plugin_actions.description: Print the no-JavaScript vote and flag forms on comments. They post to the hn plugin; turn off on a site without it.

powered_by.title: Powered-by link
powered_by.description: Show a link to Hatamoto under the footer menu.

powered_by_label.title: Powered-by link text
powered_by_label.default: Run your own Hacker News on Hatamoto
